facts.fact: 说乔治·迈克尔头发里的金色挑染在精选集里好看：Highlights reel 双关精选集／挑染，答者理解成“挑染是真的，不是假发”
facts.anchor: ‘Highlights reel?’ ‘I presume they were, yeah, I don’t think it could have been a wig.’

facts.fact: 会弹四首曲子的中国饼干：four-tune cookies，谐音 fortune cookies（幸运饼干）
facts.anchor: They are, of course, four-tune cookies.

facts.fact: 说要发一张下流淫秽的唱片，对方问 Seedy？（CD），答“不，只有黑胶、磁带、流媒体或下载”
facts.anchor: ‘I’m releasing a record of music that is really sordid, sleazy and disreputable.’ ‘Seedy?’ ‘No. It’s only on vinyl, cassette, streaming or download.’

facts.fact: 贝多芬为什么把鸡送走：它们只会叫“巴赫、巴赫”——Bach 谐音 back（咯咯叫）
facts.anchor: Why did Beethoven get rid of his chickens? All they said was ‘Bach, Bach, Bach …’

facts.fact: 把钢琴掉进矿井得到什么：A flat miner，谐音 A flat minor（降A小调）
facts.anchor: What do you get if you drop a piano down a mineshaft? A flat miner.

facts.fact: 古典作曲家去超市带什么：Chopin Liszt，谐音 shopping list（购物清单）
facts.anchor: What does a classical composer take to the supermarket? A Chopin Liszt.

facts.fact: 问更喜欢哪种修士，答 No chants（不唱诵），谐音 no chance（没门）
facts.anchor: Will you tell me which type you prefer?’‘No chants.’‘Oh, go on.’

facts.fact: 中央C、降E、G走进酒吧，酒保说“我们不招待 minors”——minor 双关小调音程／未成年人
facts.anchor: Middle C, E flat and G walk into a bar. ‘Sorry,’ the barman said. ‘We don’t serve minors.’

facts.fact: 两只鼓和一片镲掉下悬崖，拟声词正是架子鼓收尾音效
facts.anchor: Two drums and a cymbal fall off a cliff. Ba-dum-tssh!

facts.fact: 请乐队演奏鹰嘴豆之歌，他们说“你先 hummus 几小节”——hummus 谐音 hum us（哼给我们听）
facts.anchor: I asked a band if they could play the Chickpea Song. They said, ‘Maybe. Can you hummus a few bars?’
